issues.title: Ingest Cleburne County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $17,979,197 across 39 funds. The largest: County General Fund ($8,196,630), County Road ($6,072,565), Jail Maintenance Sales Tax ($827,018). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
